thread:
alex (support): Hey @sam — saw your ticket. You mentioned a bunch of 502s and TLS handshake timeouts hitting our hosted inference API since ~09:12 UTC. Can you paste the curl/openssl output?

sam (customer): yep. repro steps: `curl -v https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -d '{"input":"test"}'` -> hangs then `curl: (35) SSL handshake returned EOF` then `HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway` occasionally. Happening from our eu-west-1 app instances only.

alex (support): thanks. Any errors in your side like resolver timeouts?

sam (customer): `dig api.redwood.example.com +short` gives 18.195.23.8 and 2a04:4e42::1234 (we're dual-stack). TTL shows 300. Traceroute looks fine.

maria (sre): Jumping in — Maria (oncall SRE). We're seeing an uptick in 502/gateway errors from our edge proxies around 09:10-09:30 UTC. Error pattern: upstream TLS handshake timeout and `upstream prematurely closed connection` from envoy. Not all regions impacted.

priya (eng-runtime): Priya here. Any recent cert rotations or ALB changes? We rotated a wildcard cert yesterday evening but that rollout was to hosted-control-plane only — shouldn't touch data plane. Deploy bot: `deploy-bot: cert-rotation/wildcard-2025-11-17 completed at 21:04 UTC`

alex (support): sam — can you run `openssl s_client -connect api.redwood.example.com:443 -servername api.redwood.example.com -brief` from one of your failing hosts and paste output? Also run with `-4` and `-6` to see IPv4 vs IPv6 behavior.

sam (customer): pasted. IPv4 ok, gets cert chain and connection. IPv6 `connect: Connection timed out` then `handshake failure`. Example: `CONNECTED(00000003) 1399312:error:140070FC:SSL routines:CONNECT_CR_CERT:certificate verify failed:/...` then fallbacks.

maria (sre): That smells like an IPv6 path or resolver issue. Our edge has recently started advertising AAAA from new CDN edge nodes in EU. If some of those nodes have stale cert or private-key misconfig, clients hitting IPv6 would fail. Priya, can runtime confirm certs on ipv6 edge instances?

priya (eng-runtime): I'm pulling edge inventory now. Quick check: control-plane rotation succeeded but a small subset of eu edge hosts missed the deploy due to failing userdata hook — they still have the old cert symlink pointing to `/etc/ssl/certs/wildcard-old.pem` while LB wants new chain. That can produce SNI mismatch and handshake timeout if private key not present.

maria (sre): Nice find. That explains region-only impact and IPv6 skew (we added IPv6 to newer edges). Next steps: 1) confirm which nodes are impacted 2) rerun deploy/ssh in to reload certs or fallback to previous routing.

alex (support): Sam — temporary mitigation: can you force IPv4 egress from your app to see if that restores traffic? For nodejs: `--tls-reject-unauthorized=0` not safe; better to bind to IPv4 with `curl -4`. If that fixes, we know it's ipv6-edge path.

sam (customer): Curl -4 works consistently, requests succeed. Switching our app to prefer IPv4 for now. Thanks.

priya (eng-runtime): We're performing a targeted rolling restart of the 6 impacted eu edge hosts to pick up the correct cert bundle and key. I'll post logs.

deploy-bot: `restarting edge-eu-12 (instance-id i-0abc123) — restart started by priya`

maria (sre): Also check DNS resolver caches: if clients cached an AAAA that points to the bad host, TTL 300 means it can persist for a few minutes. We can also remove the AAAA from DNS for the affected edge set temporarily if needed.

priya (eng-runtime): Restart completed on 4/6, cert now matches expected fingerprint. `openssl s_client -connect <ip6addr>:443 -servername api.redwood.example.com` returns certificate chain and handshake completes on test host.

alex (support): Sam — once we finish restart + verification, can you confirm traffic normal from your eu hosts without forcing IPv4?

sam (customer): Verified at 09:59 UTC — endpoints success over IPv6 again. No more 502s. Will monitor.

priya (eng-runtime): Root cause: partial cert rollout — control plane rotation job marked as success despite 6 edge hosts failing the hook due to disk space issue. Key takeaway: improve post-rotation verification for data-plane edges and block-mark rotation complete only after edge health checks. Filed follow-up: `GH-5126` for rollout gating.

maria (sre): Also we'll instrument per-edge cert fingerprint telemetry to detect drift quickly.

alex (support): Closing loop with customer: Sam, we've opened a postmortem and mitigation steps. Thanks for quick repro info, especially `openssl -6` that made the difference. Anything else you need?

sam (customer): all good. appreciate the fast responses. :thumbsup:

priya (eng-runtime): Adding note: in future if you see intermittent 502s and `SSL handshake returned EOF` from curl, try IPv4 vs IPv6 test and `openssl s_client -servername` to isolate SNI/cert problems.

alex (support): Marking this thread resolved for now. Will follow up once postmortem is posted.
